rc3Rules: Alert and default-off first if queue remains non-zero after grace.
Alert and forbid blind retry if unresolved unknown attempts or open reconciliation are non-zero.
Alert and default-off first if wrong-account, wrong-route or active route conflict counters are non-zero.
Alert if duplicate provider actions become non-zero.
Treat route projection loss in CRM as a transport safety incident, not a cosmetic UI defect.
Treat Contact identity split, missing provider-proven phone persistence or duplicate MAX channel projection as a transport safety incident.

knownLimitations: Text-only release for the confirmed single Personal MAX account.
Provider confirmation means MAX accepted the message; it does not imply recipient delivery/read.
Loss of MAX web authentication still requires owner re-authentication.
RC2 repaired one pre-existing burst incident by exact provider-store evidence; it did not create replacement CRM bubbles or blind retries for 11/12/1/13/14.
RC3 repaired the two-contact Personal MAX identity split and the existing outbound bubble by exact route/provider evidence; it did not create replacement CRM bubbles or blind retries.
Operational source is canonical in Git; active containers are immutable local Docker images, not registry-pushed repo digests.
The dirty /opt/crm baseline was not rewritten during consolidation.
